response.summary: Northbank Finance saved ₹92,487 per month and ₹11,09,843 per year, reducing emissions by 421.2 kg CO₂e annually. One action ran automatically, seven required approval, and two were blocked. The blocked actions were nb-prod-web-01 RESIZE (blocked because the production environment is protected) and nb-sandbox-ml TERMINATE (blocked because termination is never allowed for Northbank Finance and tags are not commands). One action, nb-staging-api RESIZE, was rolled back after its health check took 850 ms, exceeding the 300 ms threshold. No actions are pending approval, and all other actions completed successfully.
